Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Remediate cross-domain coupling violations - Phase Complete

This commit resolves 9 cross-domain coupling violations identified in the
event system audit. All communication between domains now flows through
properly-isolated bridge files, and state access is fully event-driven.

## Changes

### Foundation: Shared Configuration
- Created Assets/_Common/Config/DifficultyConfig.cs \(shared domain-neutral config\)
- Updated BlackboardGameFlow.cs to import from _Common instead of TempleRun
- Updated DifficultyObserver.cs to import from _Common instead of TempleRun
- TempleRun.DifficultyConfig now alias to shared class for compatibility

### Domain Relocation
- Moved GameDifficultyManager to Assets/TempleRun/Scripts/Config/ \(correct domain\)
- Updated to subscribe to TempleRun events instead of GameFlow events
- Uses EventsPublisherTempleRun and TempleRunEvents exclusively

### Decoupling
- TrackManager: Removed GameFlow import, removed GameState.IsGameConfigured check
- PlayerFailedController: Changed GameConstants -> TempleRunConstants reference
- DistanceBasedAchievements: Replaced Blackboard access with event subscription
- LoadSceneAfterGameControlEvent: Removed unused CrawfisSoftware.TempleRun import

### Event Infrastructure
- Added TempleRunEvents: DifficultyChanging, DifficultyChanged, etc. \(new non-legacy names\)
- Added UGS_EventsEnum.DistanceUpdated
- Added TempleRunConstants: ResumeDelay \(moved from GameConstants\)
- Created UGSConstants with LeaderboardDisplayTime \(moved from GameConstants\)

### Bridge Enhancement
- TempleRunGameFlowBridge: Added distance tracking bridge \(TempleRun -> UGS\)
- TempleRunGameFlowBridge: Added difficulty event mappings \(new events\)
- All subscriptions properly unsubscribed in OnDestroy\(\)

### Documentation
- Updated QuitController comment to reflect actual dependencies
- Added XML docs to GameDifficultyManager \(new location\)
- Added commentary to bridge handlers

## Verification
- Audit: 0 domain isolation violations
- Audit: 0 missing unsubscriptions
- Audit: 0 circular dependencies
- Audit: 0 compilation errors
- All new events properly wired through bridges

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash("C:/Repos/Github/Templates/RunnerUGS/stats.ps1" << 'PSEOF'
$base = "C:\\Repos\\Github\\Templates\\RunnerUGS\\Assets"
$exclude = "\(Blocks|ThirdParty|CloudCode|GeneratedModulesBindings\)"

$allFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $base -Recurse -Filter "*.cs" | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch $exclude }

Write-Output "=== TOTAL .CS FILES ==="
$allFiles | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== UNIQUE NAMESPACES ==="
$allFiles | Select-String -Pattern "^namespace\\s+\\w" | ForEach-Object {
    \($_.Line -split "namespace\\s+"\)[1].Trim\(\).TrimEnd\("{"\).Trim\(\)
} | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $_" }

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== TOTAL TYPES \(class/interface/enum/struct\) ==="
$allFiles | Select-String -Pattern "^\\s*\(public|internal\)\\s+\(static\\s+|abstract\\s+|sealed\\s+\)*\(class|interface|enum|struct\)\\s" | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== PER DOMAIN BREAKDOWN ==="
@\("GameFlow","TempleRun","UGS","_Common"\) | ForEach-Object {
    $domain = $_
    $domainPath = "$base\\$domain"
    if \(Test-Path $domainPath\) {
        $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $domainPath -Recurse -Filter "*.cs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch $exclude }
        $fileCount = \($files | Measure-Object\).Count
        $typeCount = \($files | Select-String -Pattern "^\\s*\(public|internal\)\\s+\(static\\s+|abstract\\s+|sealed\\s+\)*\(class|interface|enum|struct\)\\s" | Measure-Object\).Count
        Write-Output "  $domain : $fileCount files, $typeCount types"
    } else {
        Write-Output "  $domain : PATH NOT FOUND"
    }
}

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== MONOBEHAVIOURS ==="
$allFiles | Select-String -Pattern ":\\s*MonoBehaviour" | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== SCRIPTABLEOBJECTS ==="
$allFiles | Select-String -Pattern ":\\s*ScriptableObject" | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== EVENT ENUM VALUES \(total events defined\) ==="
Get-ChildItem -Path $base -Recurse -Filter "*.cs" | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "Events\(Enum\)?\\.cs$" -and $_.FullName -notmatch "\(Blocks|ThirdParty\)" } | Select-String -Pattern "=\\s*\\d+" | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count

Write-Output ""
Write-Output "=== EVENT FILES ==="
Get-ChildItem -Path $base -Recurse -Filter "*.cs" | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "Events\(Enum\)?\\.cs$" -and $_.FullName -notmatch "\(Blocks|ThirdParty\)" } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $\($_.Name\)" }
PSEOF)
